Does not follow links from an X-Robots-Tag nofollow page when robots directives are respected

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import crawl, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_depth=1, respect_robots_txt=True)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(len(result.pages))
    print(result.pages[0].nofollow_detected)
    print(result.pages[0].noindex_detected)

asyncio.run(main())
```
